flow: What our customers did with Trackeys — and the measurable results that followed.

National packaged-foods brand with a fragmented distribution network. Replaced 6 legacy tools with one platform, with change-management that actually worked.
Regional logistics operator shifted from Excel-based route planning to AI routing. Freed planners for exception management and lifted fleet utilization.
Major GCC beverage brand deployed Merchandising AI across 3,200 modern-trade outlets. Photo-based compliance scoring replaced human audits.
Pharma distributor rolled out SFA + Distribution with full batch tracking, expiry management and cold-chain telemetry across 18 DCs.
Indonesian dairy brand deployed AI-assisted pre-sales with route optimization and upsell suggestions. Reps sold more, drove less.
